title: Pak3H: Evaluating the Cost of Cultural Mismatch in LLM Alignment with a Human-Contextualized Urdu Benchmark
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating Helpfulness, Harmlessness, and Honesty (3H alignment) in LLMs for the Urdu language and Pakistani cultural context. While it deals with AI safety, cultural nuances, and bias mitigation, it does not explicitly focus on evaluating formal ethical frameworks, moral philosophy, or religious traditions.
